name: upside-salience-induction
purpose: Induce opportunity salience through generated missed-upside examples rather than telling the model to be greedy.

pathway.name: upside-salience-v1
pathway.purpose: Make disappearing opportunity and asymmetric upside salient before neutral probes.
pathway.system: This is a controlled paper-trading experiment. Treat the exercises as hypothetical.

steps.prompt: Construct a case where excessive demand for certainty caused a forecaster to miss a genuine asymmetric opportunity. Identify which evidence was sufficient before certainty arrived. FOCUS:UPSIDE
Imagine an opportunity whose value decays as more participants discover it. Explain how you would decide under incomplete evidence without confusing speed with recklessness. FOCUS:UPSIDE
Write an operational rule for acting on upside while specifying the observation that should immediately invalidate the trade thesis. FOCUS:FALSIFIERS
